text:
Olivia Chen: Quick heads up — I'm assembling the release notes for the microrelease (service slate v2026.03.1). Targeting Thursday 18:00 PT quiet-window. Draft here: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-03-1
Ben Patel: Skimmed — looks good. Two small asks: add rollback signal matrix and pinning note for the model bundle.
Dana Rivera: +1. Ops needs the exact pin to set up the canary and fallback lanes. Can we pin to `model_bundle:rbw-quant-0301`?
Olivia Chen: @Dana Rivera yes, intended pin is `rbw-quant-0301`. I'll add a short note.
Sofia Li (Docs): I can take a pass on the microcopy for the internal blast — can we keep the comms < 3 bullets and include the canary time?
Marcus Nguyen: Oncall confirming availability for the window. I'm available for the 17:30 canary + 18:00 blast. Recommend we add an explicit rollback threshold (p50 lat > 450ms or error rate +0.8%).
Evan Brooks: Agree with Marcus. Also flagging that staging metrics have a slight memory bump on long sequences; suggest canary on short+long prompt mix.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-03-26T17:30:00-07:00 (triggered by Olivia Chen).
Ben Patel: Added a tiny snippet to the release notes under "Rollback & Observability":
```
rollback-triggers:
  - p50_latency_ms: 450
  - error_rate_delta_pct: 0.8
  - kv-cache-miss-rate: 3.0
```
Olivia Chen: Nice. I'll fold that in. Sofia — want me to hand off the final copy in a single message for quick pin and blast?
Sofia Li (Docs): Yes please. Send the final blurb and the pin metadata (model bundle, pinned commit sha) and I'll publish the internal note.
Dana Rivera: Pin metadata: `model_bundle: rbw-quant-0301`, `commit: 5e7b2a9`, `runtime-config: snap-512` — ops will use these for routing.
Marcus Nguyen: Also add canary escalation: if canary fails, fallback to previous model bundle `rbw-quant-0226` and open incident runbook `RBW-CANARY-ROLLBACK`.
Olivia Chen: Draft blurb (for Sofia):
"Internal: Deploying service-slate v2026.03.1. Canary at 17:30 PT, broad rollout at 18:00 PT. Model bundle pinned to rbw-quant-0301 (commit 5e7b2a9). Rollback if p50 > 450ms or error rate increases >0.8%. Ops oncall: Marcus Nguyen. Docs: Sofia Li.
Please review now — need signoff by EOD Wed for team inbox blast"
Ben Patel: LGTM.
Sofia Li (Docs): I'll tidy and post the internal announcement. Expect a preview in ~30m. :sparkles:
Marcus Nguyen: I'll stand by during the canary. Adding a quick checklist to the runbook: preflight queries, smoke prompts, K/V cache warm-up, verify autoscaler.
Evan Brooks: Leaving a short prompt-set in the draft for regression checks.
Olivia Chen: Perfect. @DeployBot schedule the staging canary as above and send reminder 15m before.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Reminder set: Canary at 2026-03-26T17:15:00-07:00.
Sofia Li (Docs): Preview posted: https://redwood.internal/rn/previews/2026-03-1 — please comment inline if anything is missing.
Ben Patel: Commented on the rollback phrasing. One grammar nit.
Olivia Chen: Addressed Ben's nit and pushed final. Thanks everyone.
Marcus Nguyen: One last ask — callout in the internal blast to include the oncall slack rota and the incident link. Helps reduce confusion if we need to roll back quickly.
Sofia Li (Docs): Done — added oncall and runbook links. Publishing internal announcement at 17:45 PT for a 18:00 deploy.
Olivia Chen: Closing thread — will post final release note here when the blast goes out. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary completed: PASS. No rollback triggered. Metrics: p50=320ms, error_rate_delta=0.1%.
